=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1002-1012 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: In redact_earlier_items(), a plain-text `owner/repo` name of a private repository that this run did not audit is kept in the earlier-report title. The substitution loop only rewrites names in `redacted_names`, and EARLIER_REPORT_TITLE_REPO_RE only drops `github.com/<owner>/<repo>` links. This covers repositories that were excluded, cut by ISSUE_PR_AUDIT_MAX_REPOS, or lost to the `fallback=self` discovery fallback, where `redacted_names` is empty.
  WHY: The title reaches the `earlier-report-plans` model input, and the model can repeat it in the new report that reaches the public default branch through the chore-skip PR, which contradicts the docstring's drop rule at lines 983-984. Severity disagreement: four reviewers rated it MAJOR and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT because the earlier PR is already public; the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1015-1027, 1295 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: prior_aud_titles() returns fix-plan titles from the newest audit report on the checkout without redaction, and render_model_input() line 1295 passes them to the model as `previous-plan-title` entries, bypassing the redaction that redact_earlier_items() applies to `aud_titles`.
  WHY: Private `owner/repo` names from a report written with redaction off are fed to the model on a later redacting run and can reappear in the new public report, so redaction is inconsistent across the two title paths. Severity disagreement: three reviewers rated it MAJOR and anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 rated it NIT because the source report is already public; the highest (MAJOR→high) is used.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:1006 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5]
  PROBLEM: In redact_earlier_items(), the negative lookahead `(?![A-Za-z0-9_.-])` excludes `.`, so a redacted repository name followed by sentence punctuation (e.g. "owner/secret.") is not rewritten, and the line 1007 `EARLIER_REPORT_TITLE_REPO_RE` drop check does not catch it either.
  WHY: The private name passes into the `earlier-report-plans` model input and can be repeated in the new report; minimal fix is lookahead `(?![A-Za-z0-9_-]|\.[A-Za-z0-9_-])`.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh:150 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: ipa_analyze() calls `python3 -I -B "${SCRIPT_DIR}/check_issue_pr_audit_report.py"` without explicitly propagating a non-0/1 exit status if the checker crashes.
  WHY: A crashing checker may not print the required summary line, and the run script's handling of the crash should be explicit to prevent false positives.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:classify() peer construction (`peers = window + [item for item in record.get("open") or [] if item not in window]`), waste_signals() duplicate_title branch | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The duplicate_title signal compares only against the current window plus the open snapshot, so a same-title item created within 7 days whose `updated_at` predates the cursor is never compared.
  WHY: The `issue_duplicate` / `duplicate_title` signal silently misses such duplicates, although the `<= 7 * 86400` check shows the code intends a 7-day lookback.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:classify() cursor advancement, state_update(), required_report_refs(); scripts/check_issue_pr_audit_report.py required_refs() | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A flagged item omitted from the model input by the 600,000-byte cap is exempt from the report requirement, state_update() requeues only omitted new blocked items, and the repository cursor advances anyway.
  WHY: The omitted flagged item falls outside the next window and is never revisited, so the report passes validation while that item is permanently dropped from coverage.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

  expected_change_site: env blocks of the steps that run scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml (add `APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA: ${{ vars.APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA || 'analysis/issue-pr-audit-*.md' }}`)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: Neither workflow file is in the PR diff, and their hand-off step environments pass APPLY_ANALYSIS_ON_MAIN_ENABLED but not APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA, so setting the variable has no effect. README.md (README.md:198), changelog.d/10153-issue-pr-audit.md and agents.d/10153-issue-pr-audit.md document the limitation. Both files are outside the plan grant, so the fix needs a follow-up issue or a wider grant.
- requirement: "duplicate_title: normalized title equal to another item in the same repository within 7 days."
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py classify() peer collection (line 1070) and the duplicate-title check in waste_signals()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: classify() builds peers only from the current window and the open snapshot (line 1070), and no fetch covers items whose last update predates the cursor. A same-repository item created within 7 days but closed and last updated before the cursor is therefore never compared.
- requirement: "Every flagged URL and every new blocked URL must appear in one of the report sections, exactly as given." / "Every flagged item, and a seeded sample of clean ones, gets a model verdict" (G3)
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit.py state_update() (line 1418), render_model_input() (lines 1312-1341) and cursor handling in classify() (line 1067); scripts/check_issue_pr_audit_report.py required_refs()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: render_model_input() marks entries omitted at the input cap (lines 1330-1334), and required_refs() and the checker exclude omitted entries (lines 1345-1349). state_update() requeues only omitted new blocked entries (line 1418), with no equivalent branch for omitted flagged entries. The cursor advances at line 1067 regardless, so omitted flagged items are never revisited.
- requirement: The Metrics Appendix reports "API calls, tokens and cost, durations".
  expected_change_site: scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh ipa_analyze() (the finalize `--metric` arguments), the engine call path, and scripts/issue_pr_audit.py finalize_report()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  EVIDENCE: ipa_analyze() passes the fixed strings `model_tokens=unavailable` and `model_cost=unavailable`, and no hunk captures real usage from either the Claude or the codex path.

=== FINDINGS FROM anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 ===
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:redact_earlier_items(), line 1006 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The negative lookahead excludes `.`, so a redacted repository name followed by sentence punctuation ("AUD-003: Fix scope guard in owner/secret.") is never rewritten, and the line 1007 `EARLIER_REPORT_TITLE_REPO_RE` drop check does not catch it either.
  WHY: The private `owner/repo` name passes into the `earlier-report-plans` block and can be repeated in the new public report, although exposure is limited because the earlier PR is already visible; fix with lookahead `(?![A-Za-z0-9_-]|\.[A-Za-z0-9_-])` (about 1 line).
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:redact_earlier_items(), lines 1004-1011 (line 988 `redacted_names`; drop rule lines 1007-1009) | severity=NIT | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: A plain-text `owner/repo` mention of a repository this run did not audit (excluded, capped, or missed by `fallback=self` discovery) is neither rewritten nor dropped, contrary to the docstring, while unknown item URLs are dropped (lines 996-999).
  WHY: A title such as "AUD-006: Fix gate in owner/unlisted-private" reaches the model input unchanged, so the two paths are inconsistent; the earlier PR is already public.
- scripts/issue_pr_audit.py:prior_aud_titles() (line 1015 onward), render_model_input() line 1295 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Fix-plan titles from the newest report on the checkout feed the model through a parallel path that `redact_earlier_items` never touches.
  WHY: Private names from a report written with redaction off go into the `previous-plan-title` block unchanged; fix in collect() by sharing the title-redaction helper (about 5 lines).
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "APPLY_ANALYSIS_DOC_GLOB_EXTRA=none stops the hand-off" | Expected change site: env blocks of the steps that run scripts/apply_analysis_on_main.sh in .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml and .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml | Evidence of absence: neither workflow is in the diff, and README.md, the changelog fragment and the agents.d fragment document the limitation; the files are outside files_touched, so the fix needs a follow-up issue or a wider grant | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: Metrics Appendix reports "API calls, tokens and cost, durations" | Expected change site: engine invocation and finalize `--metric` arguments in scripts/issue_pr_audit_run.sh ipa_analyze() | Evidence of absence: fixed `model_tokens=unavailable` and `model_cost=unavailable` | severity=NIT | confidence=4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "duplicate_title: normalized title equal to another item in the same repository within 7 days" | Expected change site: peer collection in classify() in scripts/issue_pr_audit.py | Evidence of absence: peers come only from the window and the open snapshot, so an item created in the last 7 days, closed, and not updated since the cursor is never compared | severity=NIT | confidence=3
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: redact_earlier_items() line 1006 lookahead fix (1 line); collect() `"prior_aud_titles": prior_aud_titles(checkout)` passed through the same title-redaction helper (5 lines); HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1
